assumptions.engine: Versioned extension of retained V21 transverse symmetric half-bed parallel-channel model with local gas, solid, wall and heater states and generalized site storage.
assumptions.hardware: KNF N922 50 Hz reference curve, 135 W running input, 2 kW heater, one combined 2 kW cooling budget at COP 3, and an ideal pump-inlet knockout targeting 55 C.
assumptions.humidity: Humidity is gas forcing; the selected material adapter owns the water equilibrium law.
assumptions.pressure_control: Reviewed V21 throttle controller uses the maximum local cell pressure and the common regeneration target.
assumptions.transport: Axial breakthrough and manifold redistribution are not resolved.
